Nuclear ballistic missile submarine.requires: reactor running continuously, deep water for concealment
Nuclear ballistic missile submarine.provides: constant machinery noise, large magnetic mass, unlimited endurance, never surfaces

Diesel-electric on batteries.requires: periodic surfacing or snorkelling to recharge
Diesel-electric on batteries.provides: near-silent running, limited submerged endurance, moderate magnetic mass

Autonomous underwater vehicle.provides: very low noise, negligible magnetic signature, small size, no crew

Surface vessel towing array.provides: visible on radar, large wake, loud, no concealment

Seabed hydrophone array.requires: fixed cabled installation on the sea floor
Seabed hydrophone array.provides: passive listening over wide areas, long baseline, no coverage outside its field

Towed array on a frigate.provides: mobile passive listening, own-ship noise interference, active sonar option

Maritime patrol aircraft sonobuoys.provides: rapid wide-area search, magnetic anomaly detection, hours of endurance only

Satellite synthetic aperture radar.requires: line of sight to the sea surface
Satellite synthetic aperture radar.provides: surface imaging only, no subsurface penetration whatsoever

Radiated machinery noise.provides: passive detection at long range, defeated by silent running

Active sonar return.requires: transmitting a pulse and revealing own position
Active sonar return.provides: range and bearing on any hull, defeated by shallow reverberation

Magnetic anomaly.requires: a large ferrous mass within a few hundred metres
Magnetic anomaly.provides: confirmation at very short range only

Surface wake signature.requires: the target at or very near the surface
Surface wake signature.provides: detection from the air or space, nothing for a submerged target

Deep open ocean.requires: water depth of thousands of metres
Deep open ocean.provides: good sound propagation, room to hide vertically, far from shore installations

Shallow continental shelf.provides: severe reverberation, no vertical concealment, close to shore

Strong thermocline layering.provides: sound channels that bend and trap acoustic energy, concealment below the layer

Heavy surface shipping noise.provides: high ambient noise masking passive detection

_v1_notes.TARGET|SENSOR PLATFORM: satellite radar cannot see beneath the surface at all, so it is N for all three submerged targets and Y only for the surface vessel. A seabed array is N for an AUV: a battery-driven small hull radiates almost nothing for a passive listener at long baseline.
_v1_notes.TARGET|DETECTION PHENOMENON: machinery noise is N for a diesel-electric on batteries (that is the point of batteries) and N for an AUV. Magnetic anomaly is N for an AUV, which has negligible ferrous mass. Wake signature is N for anything submerged.
_v1_notes.TARGET|WATER CONDITION: an SSBN on the shallow continental shelf is N: it has no vertical concealment and no operational reason to be there. An AUV in deep open ocean is N: battery endurance does not reach mid-ocean.
_v1_notes.SENSOR PLATFORM|DETECTION PHENOMENON: a seabed array is passive and fixed, so active sonar, magnetic anomaly and wake are all N. A towed array cannot detect magnetic anomaly or wake. Sonobuoys do not image wakes. Satellite radar sees wake only.
_v1_notes.SENSOR PLATFORM|WATER CONDITION: satellite radar is N under a thermocline condition, which is a subsurface phenomenon irrelevant to surface imaging - the pairing has no case.
_v1_notes.DETECTION PHENOMENON|WATER CONDITION: machinery noise is N under heavy shipping noise, which masks it. Active sonar is N on the shallow shelf, where reverberation defeats it. Magnetic anomaly is unaffected by all four. Wake is N under thermocline layering for the same irrelevance reason.
